'''S.S. Murata''' is a [[San Marino|Sanmarinese]] [[football (soccer)|football]] club, based in [[Murata (San Marino)|Murata]], a civil parish of the city of [[City of San Marino|San Marino]]. The club was founded in [[1966 in association football|1966]]. Murata currently plays in [[Campionato Sammarinese di Calcio]]. The team's colours are black and white."}}
